_source: Google Cloud public list prices, verified against cloud.google.com/run/pricing and cloud.google.com/products/observability/pricing on 2026-10-02.
_note: List prices only. Free-tier allotments are applied by engine/cost.py before charging. Prices are USD. Tier-1 regions (us-central1, asia-south1 and other standard regions) share these rates.

cloudMonitoring._chargeableNote: Custom metrics, external metrics and USER-DEFINED log-based metrics are chargeable by bytes ingested; the first 150 MiB per billing account per month is free. Google Cloud system metrics are non-chargeable and do not count toward the allotment.
